items.title: Ralph LaLama interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 23, 2010
items.q: did a couple of benefits for Phyllis [Monterose], I remember with Nick [Brignola] and Joe Mags [Magnarelli] and you know Rick [Montalbano].

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe and I am off-camera for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive, and I am very pleased to be speaking with saxophonist Ralph LaLama today. Welcome back to Utica, New York.

Thank you, Monk. Yeah, it’s nice to be here. We had a good gig yesterday, two gigs, yes. People are nice around here. You know I used to play here. Tiny’s and do some concerts, and did a bunch of stuff for J.R. [Monterose], did a couple of benefits for Phyllis [Monterose], I remember with Nick [Brignola] and Joe Mags [Magnarelli] and you know Rick [Montalbano]. I remember Rick [Montalbano] Junior —
